scope: Single grouped Commit GUI staging fixture across system and bundled Git; cached app receiver module, fixture-only compilation. No Core/app build or other native suites.
preservedAssertions: Exact Git status before/after every capture
Stage/unstage selected paths, partial/untracked/deleted identity and unrelated-index preservation
Loading/empty panes, ownership/selection rejection and worker drain
limitations: Focused local success does not establish a complete hosted CI pass or physical native double-click acceptance.

hosted_failure.diagnosis: The fixture saved screenshots inside its tested working tree; refresh discovered two new untracked paths, widened the Path column and showed a horizontal scrollbar. The geometry change was caused by unintended test input, not a demonstrated production regression.

repair: Move captures and the empty test repository to private siblings outside the primary working tree. Assert exact NUL-delimited porcelain-v2 Git status before and after every capture. Preserve all original geometry/scroll/transfer and lifetime assertions.
